es.heroDescription: División marítima de MS Group, especializada en el manejo comercial y operativo de buques como Operadores, Charterers y Brokers de cargas y buques.
es.serviceIntroDescription: Desde 1990, MS Shipping opera desde Argentina como división marítima de MS Group, especializada en el manejo comercial y operativo de buques como Operadores, Charterers y Brokers para clientes locales e internacionales.

en.heroDescription: A division of MS Group, specializing in the commercial and operational management of vessels as Ship Operators, Charterers, and Cargo & Ship Brokers.
en.serviceIntroDescription: Since 1990, MS Shipping has operated from Argentina as the maritime division of MS Group, specializing in the commercial and operational management of vessels as Ship Operators, Charterers and Brokers for local and international clients.
